crossRefs.note: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
Blessed be Yahweh, my rock, who teaches my hands to war, and my fingers to battle:
Our God, will you not judge them? For we have no might against this great company that comes against us. We don’t know…
But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of…
Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.
Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
He struck them hip and thigh with a great slaughter; and he went down and lived in the cave in Etam’s rock.
For Yahweh’s hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down…
“I have trodden the wine press alone. Of the peoples, no one was with me. Yes, I trod them in my anger and trampled…
And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
Now thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge…

translations.web: Through God, we will do valiantly. For it is he who will tread down our enemies.
translations.bsb: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
translations.kjv: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
translations.asv: Through God we shall do valiantly: For he it is that will tread down our adversaries. Psalm 109 For the Chief Musicion. A Psalm of David.
